prompt_text: Who is the best mortgage lender in St. Charles MO for a home purchase loan?
engine_stated_criteria: A good local starting point is First State Bank of St. Charles
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” lender—the right choice depends on your credit, down payment, loan type, and the lender’s actual rate and fees. **A good local starting point is First State Bank of St. Charles**: it has a mortgage center in town and offers purchase loans. **Integrity Mortgage** is another local option, with a reported 4.8/5 Google rating based on 37 reviews in the available search results.

Before choosing, get written **Loan Estimates** from at least three lenders for the same loan amount, down payment, and rate-lock period. Compare the APR, lender fees, points, closing timeline, and responsiveness—not just the advertised rate. You could also include a credit union or a national lender in the comparison.

Sources: [First State Bank mortgage center](https://fsbfinancial.com/about-us/locations/2850-west-clay-street/) · [Integrity Mortgage](https://integritymo.com/)
